result.brief: 提出 Stateful Harness 框架，将世界状态演化与视频渲染解耦，用冻结视频模型渲染事件并回写状态，并构建 WorldState-Bench 评估隐藏状态下的规则遵循。
result.reason: Proposes a harness separating rule-based world-state evolution from frozen video-model rendering for action-conditioned world interaction, plus a benchmark for hidden-state rule compliance.
